description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractEndpointResult' that implements methods for handling API endpoint results, including normalization and management of metadata and relations. It serves as a base class for specific endpoint result implementations within the OrangeHRM system's API v2 serializer module.

classes.name: AbstractEndpointResult
classes.description: An abstract base class for API endpoint result representations, providing normalization interface and management of meta and relationship data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the endpoint result with a model class, data, and optional meta and relationship ParameterBags; throws exception if class not found.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Abstract method that should return the normalized data as an associative array.
